title: Caught Eating the Rice: Whale Maiden's Carbohydrate Sampling Mission

camera.move: slow push-in following the POV walk

shots.lighting: warm 3000K tungsten key light from the left, soft fill, shallow depth of field with the background blurred
shots.visual: POV walk-in shot: warm yellow kitchen, steam rising from an electric rice cooker at frame center; the DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, blue-and-white gradient ponytail and a small whale-fin accessory on top of her head, barefoot, on tiptoe holding a big bowl, chopsticks lifting a huge ball of white rice to her mouth, background softly blurred.
shots.character_action: on tiptoe behind the counter, back to camera, shovels rice into her mouth with chopsticks; hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly without turning around and keeps chewing hard
shots.expression: cheeks puffed out like a hamster, jaw working hard, face still turned away from camera

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: ... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Take another bite for sampling--

sfx.cue: wet, loud chewing close to the camera

shots.bgm: 0-5s warm kitchen ambience: boiling water and a distant TV, then cuts to fast choral percussion

shots.lighting: warm tungsten key light, a cool blue rim light on her ponytail, background blurred
shots.visual: POV shot: the owner's right hand enters from the right edge of frame and taps the dining table twice; the Whale Maiden freezes with her chopsticks suspended in the air, then slowly turns her head toward the camera, rice grains stuck at the corners of her mouth, blue-and-white ponytail swinging.
shots.character_action: freezes mid-chew with chopsticks hanging in the air, then slowly rotates her head toward the camera without swallowing
shots.expression: trembling pupils, the highlights in her eyes turning into rotating loading circles, cheeks still full

sfx.cue: two crisp table taps from the right

shots.lighting: warm yellow tungsten key light, cool blue rim on her hair, blurred background
shots.visual: POV close shot: the Whale Maiden faces the camera, ponytail whipping, frantically scooping the rest of the bowl into her mouth with rice grains flying, playback sped up 1.5x, warm yellow light with a cool blue rim, background blurred.
shots.character_action: scoops rice in a blur of motion, hugging the bowl with one arm, leaning toward the lens
shots.expression: wide pleading eyes with rotating loading circles, eyebrows raised in panic

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

sfx.cue: spring boing plus a fast subjective heartbeat

lens_fx: rice grains smeared on the lens
brief defocus as the camera steps back
shots.lighting: warm yellow key light, slight cool bounce on her face, background blurred by the smeared rice
shots.visual: POV close-up: rice grains smear directly onto the lens and break the fourth wall; the DeepSeek Whale Maiden's cheeks bulge to the limit, grains stuck on the collar of the loose T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo at the hem, her eyes pleading into the camera while the handheld frame shakes backward.
shots.character_action: desperately chews and swallows, presses the empty bowl against her chest with both hands, leans toward the lens
shots.expression: cheeks puffed to the limit, teary pleading eyes, rice grains stuck on her lips

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

sfx.cue: chopsticks clattering against the empty bowl

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.on_screen_text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen key light, soft cool rim light, shallow focus
shots.visual: POV medium shot: the Whale Maiden stands up straight facing the camera, two rice grains on her lips, whale-fin hair accessory tilted, hands behind her back, the DeepSeek logo on her T-shirt hem lifted by a visibly bulging belly, warm yellow light and cool blue rim on her ponytail.
shots.character_action: swallows the last mouthful, straightens up, hides both hands behind her back, clears her throat and lifts her chin
shots.expression: innocent yet smug smile, eyes sliding sideways, one eyebrow raised

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Cough. Checking rice's semantic integrity. Taste model needs training data. Don't look at me like that.

shots.lighting: warm tungsten key light from the kitchen, soft fill, background in shallow focus
shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position, the owner's face never shown and his low-pitched voice coming from behind the camera: the Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with a DeepSeek-style chat bubble floating above her head, warm yellow kitchen behind her, blue-and-white ponytail and whale-fin accessory clearly lit.
shots.character_action: flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then freezes mid-wink as the low remark lands: eyebrows twitch, eyes dart down to her bulging belly, then she snaps back into a fake smile
shots.expression: a smug wink collapsing into a twitching eyebrow and a quick guilty glance at her belly, then a forced smile

sfx.cue: soft notification chime as the bubble pops up

camera.move: her palm pushes the lens, frame briefly defocuses

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen light, brief flare as her palm covers the lens
shots.visual: POV close-up: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden's palm gently pushes the camera away and the frame briefly blurs into defocus, her blue-and-white ponytail and tilted whale-fin accessory filling the edge of the frame.
shots.character_action: gently pushes the camera away with her palm, tilts her head, sticks out her tongue slightly

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: This is just cache! Go away!

sfx.cue: boop~ and glass friction as her palm touches the lens

deviations.original: Cough. I'm just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. The DeepSeek taste model requires a large amount of training data, you know. Don't look at me like that.
deviations.new: Cough. Checking rice's semantic integrity. Taste model needs training data. Don't look at me like that.
deviations.reason: beat timing: the original line is 29 English words (~11.2s of speech), but the punchline beat only has about 6s inside the 30s target
